cut: v1 (owner, 18 Oct: make it; replaces The Scoreboard) — one question: can a joke use AI to put words in a leader's mouth? Two courts, two answers.
argument: The same AI trick got two verdicts: Berlin banned a fake chancellor as not clearly satire, a US judge struck down California's label law, and EU law now asks satire for a light label.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Can a joke use AI to put words / in a leader's mouth? / Two courts, [two answers].
text.fi: Saako vitsi panna tekoälyllä / sanoja johtajan suuhun? / Kaksi oikeutta, [kaksi vastausta].
text.ja: AIで 指導者の 口に 言葉を / 入れる 冗談は 許されるか？ / 二つの 法廷、 [二つの 答え]。

captions.source: The station's question. The cases: research-satire-history.md §10 (Berlin) and §12 (California); the EU rule: §Landing, AI Act Article 50(4).

text.en: Berlin, 2024: a court banned / an AI video of the chancellor: / not clearly [satire].
text.fi: Berliini 2024: oikeus kielsi / tekoälyvideon liittokanslerista: / ei selvästi [satiiria].
text.ja: ベルリン、2024年： 裁判所は / 首相の AI動画を 禁じた。 / 明らかな [風刺] では ないと。

captions.source: Landgericht Berlin II, 15 O 579/23: a preliminary injunction for the federal government against the Zentrum für Politische Schönheit's AI-voiced Scholz video, reported 25 Feb 2024 (LTO, netzpolitik.org). Per FAZ (via turi2) the court found it not clearly recognisable as a fake or as satire: a paraphrase, so never in quote marks. No appeal outcome found, so 'banned', not 'finally'.

text.en: California, 2024: a parody ad / gave a candidate an AI voice. / A new law demanded a [label].
text.fi: Kalifornia 2024: parodiamainos / antoi ehdokkaalle tekoälyäänen. / Uusi laki vaati [merkinnän].
text.ja: カリフォルニア、2024年： パロディ広告が / 候補者に AIの 声を 与えた。 / 新法は [表示を] 求めた。

captions.source: A July 2024 parody campaign ad with a cloned candidate's voice; AB 2839, signed Sep 2024, allowed suits over deceptive election content and required parody and satire to carry labels (Reason, AI Business, Tech Policy Press).

text.en: A judge struck the law down: / answer a joke with more speech, / not a [ban].
text.fi: Tuomari kumosi lain: / vitsiin vastataan puheella, / ei [kiellolla].
text.ja: 判事は その法律を 無効に した。 / 冗談には 言論で 応えよ、 / [禁止] では なく。

captions.source: Kohls v. Bonta, US District Court, E.D. California: preliminary injunction 2 Oct 2024; struck down as facially unconstitutional, August 2025 (Bloomberg Law, Turley, MediaPost). 'Answer a joke with more speech' is our plain summary of the order's counter-speech reasoning, so it is not quoted.

text.en: EU law since August: an AI fake / must be labelled. Satire too, / just [lightly].
text.fi: EU-laki elokuusta: / tekoälyväärennös on merkittävä. / Satiirikin, mutta [kevyesti].
text.ja: EU法は 8月から： AIの 偽物には / 表示が 必要。 風刺も、 / ただし [控えめに]。

captions.source: AI Act Article 50(4), applying from 2 Aug 2026: deep fakes must be disclosed; for evidently satirical work the duty is limited to disclosing that it exists, in an appropriate manner that does not hamper the display or enjoyment of the work.

banned.why: the court stamp on the Berlin phone: a preliminary injunction against further distribution

tab.why: the court's reason as a label, a paraphrase (never in quote marks)

vote.why: the campaign poster: a candidate, unnamed

sticker.why: what AB 2839 demanded of parody; drawn as big as the poster's biggest word

bug.why: the EU's answer: a small label in the corner, like a TV channel's corner bug

post.en: Same trick, two verdicts. Berlin, 2024: a court barred an AI-voiced video of the chancellor as not clearly satire. California: a judge struck down a law demanding labels on AI parody. Since August, EU law asks for a label, kept light for satire. #AIAct #satire #EU
post.fi: Sama temppu, kaksi tuomiota. Berliini 2024: oikeus kielsi tekoälyäänellä tehdyn liittokanslerivideon, koska se ei ollut selvästi satiiria. Kalifornia: tuomari kumosi lain, joka vaati merkintää tekoälyparodiaan. Elokuusta lähtien EU-laki vaatii merkinnän, satiirilta kevyen.
post.ja: 同じ手口、二つの判決。2024年ベルリン：裁判所はAI音声の首相動画を、明らかな風刺ではないとして禁じた。カリフォルニア：判事はAIパロディに表示を求める法律を無効とした。8月から、EU法は表示を求める。風刺には控えめに。
